mapper.sql: select growth_id, baby_id, measure_date, weight_kg, height_cm, head_cm, notes, operator_id, operator_name, rev, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_by_name, update_time, remark from nc_growth
mapper.select:
del_flag = '0' and baby_id = #{babyId}
and measure_date >= to_date(#{params.beginTime},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and measure_date <= to_date(#{params.endTime},'yyyy-MM-dd')
order by measure_date desc, growth_id desc
mapper.update: update nc_growth set measure_date = #{measureDate}, weight_kg = #{weightKg}, height_cm = #{heightCm}, head_cm = #{headCm}, notes = #{notes}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_by_name = #{updateByName}, rev = rev + 1, update_time = current_timestamp where growth_id = #{growthId} and del_flag = '0' and rev = #{rev}
